daily.note: Today's macro volatility depends entirely on the US CPI data released at 13:30 EST (early morning Beijing time). items.question: How do I change my email or phone number?
items.answerHtml:
Go to Settings → Account and click Edit next to the contact method you want to change.

Changing email requires verification on the new address; changing phone requires an SMS code. For security, you can only change primary contact info once every 7 days.

items.question: How do I upgrade, downgrade, or change my plan?
items.answerHtml:
Go to Settings → Subscription and click Change plan.

  • Upgrade: takes effect immediately; you pay the prorated difference
  • Downgrade: applies at the end of the current billing cycle
  • Cancel: auto-renew stops after the current period; you keep access until then

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
The page is slow or will not load — how do I troubleshoot?
items.answerHtml:
Try these steps:

  • Refresh or hard refresh (Ctrl + Shift + R)
  • Clear cache and cookies
  • Try incognito or another browser (Chrome or Edge recommended)
  • Check your network; try another connection
  • Check status.mozi.app for outages

Still stuck? Contact technical support with screenshots or error messages.

items.question: Which browsers and devices are supported?
items.answerHtml:
We support the latest two major versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. IE 11 and below are not supported.

Mobile: iOS 15+ and Android 10+. Use the system browser or Chrome for the best experience.
